reviews.review_text:
Mark D
Campbell, California108 contributions
0
Pick your seafood, and they cook it fresh for you
Sep 2026 • Couples
The best part of Hải Sản Hoàng Gia is the format: you choose your seafood, they weigh your catch in a shopping basket before cooking, and then it's cooked to order for you. It doesn't get fresher than this. Nothing is frozen, and everything was swimming just 5 minutes before we ate it. Wow.

We had the clam soup, prawns, and Singapore chili crab, and everything was excellent. The clam soup had a nice ginger base that was comforting and flavorful, the prawns were fresh and cooked perfectly, and the Singapore chili crab was the standout: rich, spicy, and great for mopping up with bread. The dipping sauce was incredible too. I'd love to go back just to buy some, or find out where they get it.

The restaurant was super clean, with no fishy smell at all, and even the bathrooms were very clean. The staff were super friendly, and the menu is easy to read on the iPad.

It's mostly locals eating here, which is always a good sign, and I suspect it's why the reviews aren't higher. Most foreigners seem to walk right past without noticing the fresh seafood on display, since you don't find places like this in the United States.

Of course it's on the pricier side for Vietnam, but not compared to American prices. We spent $70, which is incredible for the amount of fresh seafood we ate.

A great spot for seafood in Saigon. Highly recommend, especially if you love picking your own dinner.

Hello Mr/Ms. gianfrancoa517,

Royal Seafood sincerely thanks you for choosing our restaurant and deeply regrets that your experience did not meet your expectations.

At Royal Seafood, all product prices are clearly displayed on our menu and on the seafood price boards for customers' reference before placing an order.

Regarding the wet wipes, we would like to clarify that in Vietnam, especially at many restaurants, wet wipes are commonly provided separately and are subject to a small fee. At our restaurant, the charge is 3,000 VND per wipes (approximately 10 cents).

As our restaurant specializes in seafood dishes, guests often need to peel shrimp, crab, or other shellfish, or use their hands while dining. Therefore, wet wipes are prepared in advance to help guests clean their hands, remove any lingering seafood odor, and feel comfortable throughout the meal.
